offence_note: Sexual assault of police officer; forcible entry (substituted for break and enter)
sentence_quote: While leave to appeal sentence is granted, the appeal against sentence is dismissed. The victim fine surcharge is set aside on consent.
note: Time served on sexual assault; surcharge set aside; forcible entry substituted on conviction appeal.

offence_note: Theft of cocaine by police exhibit custodian
sentence_quote: I am still unable to say that the 14-month period of incarceration for this offence and offender is unfit.
note: Breach of trust aggravating; conditional sentence rejected.

sentence_quote: In all of the circumstances, I find the joint submission for ten years is appropriate.
note: Joint submission accepted; already serving life for murder; reasons forwarded to CSC.

sentence_quote: Leave to appeal sentence is granted, but the appeal is dismissed.
note: Co-accused's 20-year ineligibility dealt with in separate reasons.

offence_note: Production and possession for trafficking of methamphetamine and ecstasy
sentence_quote: I would grant leave to appeal and allow the appeal to the extent of substituting four sentences of five years of imprisonment for the four sentences of six years imposed by the trial judge, all counts running concurrent.
note: Six years reduced to five, concurrent.

sentence_quote: In my view, the appropriate sentence is ten years in prison for the charge of attempt murder, with three years concurrent to be served for the charge of carrying a concealed weapon.
note: Would have been twelve years but for youth, remorse, progress.

offence_note: Two counts possession for trafficking; breach of probation
sentence_quote: This results in a total sentence of two years plus one day.
note: Joint submission; victim surcharge waived for hardship.

sentence_quote: We reduce the sentence to one of two years less a day imprisonment concurrent on each count.
note: Reduced from two years to avoid immigration consequences; offences not stated.

offence_note: Robbery and aggravated assault by stabbing
sentence_quote: I am going to impose a sentence of 27 months' federal time, which after consideration of the immigration consequences and the house arrest which you have endured for the last couple of years, I will reduce to a period of 24 months
note: Credit of 17 days is in addition to the 24 months; 10-year s.109 prohibition.

offence_note: Break and enter and theft in bank vault break-in
sentence_quote: In short, the sentence is fit and free from error.
note: Co-defendant Papic received same term after guilty plea; counts described as two counts of breaking and entering.

offence_note: Arson and two counts of threatening
sentence_quote: The appellant was sentenced to two years less a day imprisonment on his conviction for arson, probation for three years, and an order to pay restitution of $14,000 to the victim of the fire.
note: Threats: 3 months and 1 year concurrent; 13 months pre-trial custody, judge treated as about 26 months.

sentence_quote: In my opinion, the sentence of 27 months in prison was fit at the time it was imposed, and continues to be a fit sentence today.
note: Decision gives 27 months and also says 30 months effective after three months credit; inconsistent.
